name: Yastimadhu
subtitle: Licorice & Amla Split-End Repair
tagline: From India's Roots to Your Roots.
description: An intensive, restorative rescue blend designed to mend damaged strands and lock in moisture. Yastimadhu joins the deeply nourishing, fortifying properties of Licorice root with the vitamin-rich, age-old hair vitalizer Amla. Supported by the restorative richness of Jojoba and Argan, this concentrated formula envelops brittle ends, helps restore elasticity, and coats the hair shaft to prevent future splitting and breakages, leaving hair beautifully smooth and resilient.

ingredients.name: Licorice Root
ingredients.role: Rich in natural nutrients to help strengthen and coat the hair shaft, reducing breakage

ingredients.name: Amla Fruit
ingredients.role: Enriches with Vitamin C to fortify weakened strands and boost hair health

ingredients.name: Jojoba Seeds
ingredients.role: Mimics natural scalp oils to smooth and coat split ends

ingredients.name: Argan Nuts
ingredients.role: Infuses deep moisture and smooths frizz to protect fragile hair

whyThisHerb: Yastimadhu, or Licorice Root, is a traditional soothing powerhouse that wraps fraying hair fibers in protective, natural moisture, working alongside revitalizing Amla to mend and prevent breakage.

howToUse.title: Warm
howToUse.description: Dispense 3-4 drops onto your fingers and warm by rubbing them together.

howToUse.title: Target Ends
howToUse.description: Gently massage the oil directly into the mid-lengths and split ends of your hair.

howToUse.title: Soak
howToUse.description: Allow the rich restorative oil to absorb for 30 minutes, or use as a light leave-in treatment on damp hair.

howToUse.title: Wash & Protect
howToUse.description: Wash away with your preferred mild shampoo, or let it work as a protective shield during the day.
